title: Ascension Siren
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A subtractive saw riser that screams upward: a rising pitch envelope and ramping accelerate push the voice into the high register while a resonant ladder filter opens and tension builds, then resets every 16 cycles. Roaring detuned saws and a slow band-pass climb give it a relentless, anxious lift.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<c3 c3 eb3 g3>*4").s("sawtooth")
    .penv(saw.slow(16).range(2, 36)).pattack(0.01).pdecay(0.4)
    .accelerate(saw.slow(16).range(0, 1.5))
    .lpf(saw.slow(16).range(400, 7000)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(8, 19)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(saw.slow(32).range(1, 5)).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.3)
    .shape(sine.slow(24).range(0.2, 0.55))
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(11).range(0.1, 1.2))
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.18).sustain(0.6).release(0.08)
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.15)).gain(0.4))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .delay("0.4:0.1875:0.5").room(sine.slow(32).range(0.1, 0.5))
    .gain(0.9)
)
